Quoted lines in the prompt box now look like quotes, as they do in the transcript.

- Lines in the prompt draft that start with `>` are painted as you type, paste, or insert a quote with the ❝ quote chip or `/desk-quote`: the `>` mark is dimmed and the quoted text is italic and muted, while your question below stays plain. Only the look changes; the text, cursor and undo are untouched (uses Claude Code 2.1.311's `$.prompt.paint`)

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
